name: microwp
description: Cloudflare Workers edge engine and PHP-WASM in-isolate proof for WordPress

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.wasm:build: bun run wasm:prepare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.php-probe.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist-php-probe
scripts.wasm:dev: bun run wasm:prepare && wrangler dev --config wrangler.php-probe.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8798
scripts.native:build: bun run wasm:prepare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.native.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist-native
scripts.native:dev: bun run wasm:prepare && wrangler dev --config wrangler.native.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8799
scripts.durable:build: bun run wasm:prepare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.durable.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist-durable
scripts.durable:dev: bun run wasm:prepare && wrangler dev --config wrangler.durable.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8796
scripts.staging:build: bun run wasm:prepare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist-staging
